title: Intelligence-Superiority Feature-Board
notes: We can't beat what we haven't benchmarked. Governed competitive-intelligence contract; every BEAT/MEET carries evidence, thin/spec leads are provisional, all cells self_assessed. Sealed by tools/validate_intelligence_superiority_board.py.

categories.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
categories.description: Noetica RAG (advanced-RAG family, receipt-gated inference, GraphRAG grounded answers, embedding-space governance, temporal retrieval) vs the productized RAG field.

litmus_features.name: Advanced-RAG pattern breadth
litmus_features.definition: Number and composition of retrieval patterns fused in one governed harness.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = >=8 fused patterns (HippoRAG/RAPTOR/HyDE/CRAG-gate/temporal) in a single live library.

litmus_features.name: Replayable inference receipts
litmus_features.definition: Per-turn, hash-chained, replayable evidence for every retrieved-and-generated answer.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = open, SHA-256 hash-chained, replay-classed receipts on every turn.

litmus_features.name: Embedding-space governance
litmus_features.definition: Enforced embedding-dimension/space contract preventing silent index/query mismatch.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = fail-closed EmbeddingSpaceMismatchError + dim pin + source-scan CI guard.

litmus_features.name: GraphRAG grounded answers
litmus_features.definition: Graph-structured retrieval with per-claim grounding to a resolvable source reference.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = MS-GraphRAG + per-claim grounding + fail-closed page-reference CI contract.

litmus_features.name: Hybrid dense/lexical/graph fusion
litmus_features.definition: Reciprocal-rank fusion across dense, lexical (BM25) and graph retrieval.
litmus_features.criteria: MEET = shipping BM25 + dense RRF; BEAT requires a decisive quality edge.

litmus_features.name: Verified, resolvable citations
litmus_features.definition: Citations that are verified against source (grounding score) and resolve to an exact locus.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = verified + receipted + page-resolvable citation; MEET = strong UX parity.

litmus_features.name: Reranking quality
litmus_features.definition: Precision of the reranker over the fused candidate set.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = trained cross-encoder parity or better; PARTIAL = unsupervised RRF/MMR only.

litmus_features.name: Hallucination control
litmus_features.definition: Defenses that suppress unsupported generations (poisoned-RAG, self-consistency, grounding checks).
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = layered deterministic defense breadth; PARTIAL where a trained detector leads one axis.

litmus_features.name: Contextual retrieval + RAG-Fusion
litmus_features.definition: Contextual-chunk retrieval and query-variant RAG-Fusion.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = merged, tested contextual retrieval + RAG-Fusion; live requires ingest/query wiring.

litmus_features.name: Temporal retrieval correctness
litmus_features.definition: Retrieval filtered/validated by temporal validity of facts.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = general temporal-KG validity model; PARTIAL = scoped recency filter only.

litmus_features.name: Retrieval quality at scale
litmus_features.definition: Retrieval quality sustained at billion-document corpora.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = proven billion-doc scale; PARTIAL/GAP = workspace-scale in-memory scans.

litmus_features.name: Connector breadth + permission sync
litmus_features.definition: Breadth of source connectors with document-level permission synchronization.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = 100+ connectors with permission-sync; PARTIAL = open audited connectors, fewer.

litmus_features.name: Governance / policy gating
litmus_features.definition: Constitutional gates that can refuse an agent action (separation-of-powers invariants).
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = merged constitution + judge/objective gates that fail closed on unconstitutional acts.

litmus_features.name: Agent identity / passport
litmus_features.definition: OS-process-level agent classification and fail-closed authorization.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = OS-process->authority binding with live fail-closed authorize gate.

litmus_features.name: Receipts / auditability
litmus_features.definition: Hash-chained, deterministically-replayable proof artifacts for agent runs.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = SHA-256 proof-artifact spine + deterministic replay + sealed hygiene passports.

litmus_features.name: Standards conformance
litmus_features.definition: Coverage of open agent-interop standards under a zero-trust profile.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = HUA/AG-UI/A2A/MCP/ANP zero-trust stack + published agent-standard profiles.

litmus_features.name: OS / workspace-native
litmus_features.definition: Agents bound to OS-process authority within a sovereign workspace/OS layer.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = SourceOS + AgentPassport OS-process->authority binding.

litmus_features.name: Self-maintenance contract
litmus_features.definition: A closed sense->model->judge->act->receipt control loop for self-maintenance.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = specified closed-loop contract; live requires shipping runtime remediation.

litmus_features.name: Multi-agent orchestration
litmus_features.definition: Coordinating multiple role-specialized agents toward a shared objective.
litmus_features.criteria: MEET = conductor + role choir + A2A coordination; BEAT requires a live edge.

litmus_features.name: Governed agent memory
litmus_features.definition: Multi-type agent memory with regime characterization and governed writeback.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = FSMS multi-type memory + regime characterizer + governed writeback; MEET = raw recall parity.

litmus_features.name: Live orchestration runtime
litmus_features.definition: A production graph/runtime that actually executes multi-step agent flows.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = live executing graph; PARTIAL = deterministic dry-run router only.

litmus_features.name: Autonomous execution
litmus_features.definition: End-to-end autonomous task execution (e.g. autonomous coding).
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = executes autonomous runs; GAP = contract carrier that does not execute.

litmus_features.name: Experiment tracking
litmus_features.definition: Tracking runs, params, artifacts and comparisons across model experiments.

litmus_features.name: Receipt-gated evaluation

litmus_features.definition: Deterministic, environment-pinned replay of an eval run from a recipe.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = recipe + repro-ledger + reproduce-run-record enabling deterministic replay.

litmus_features.name: Anti-laundering honesty gate
litmus_features.definition: Structural prevention of citing a number as if it were reproduced by us.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = disjoint reproduced-vs-cited facts + a no_laundering submission gate.

litmus_features.name: LLM eval + guardrails
litmus_features.definition: Productized LLM output evaluation and guardrailing (safety/quality scorers).
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = broad governed scorers; PARTIAL where a vendor leads productization.

litmus_features.name: Governed model registry
litmus_features.definition: Model registry with governance ledger over promotions/lineage.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = registry + governance ledger; MEET = registry parity.

litmus_features.name: Production ML observability
litmus_features.definition: Live monitoring of model quality/drift in production.
litmus_features.criteria: BEAT = mature drift/quality monitoring; PARTIAL = telemetry capture only.
